cases.task: Choose the safe browser rule for SSE ready and page frames whose JSON numeric cursor may exceed JavaScript's exact integer range while the SSE id remains exact text.

required_facts.text: JSON numbers above 2^53-1 may be rounded by JavaScript even though MessageEvent.lastEventId remains exact decimal text.
Every cursor-bearing ready and page payload should include an exact canonical decimal string mirror of its SSE id.
The client must validate the decimal mirror equals lastEventId before changing the accepted cursor, otherwise close fail-closed and preserve the prior cursor.
